scope: Actual UI verification and fixes; Vercel excluded

coverage.warning: Initial viewport screenshots are not complete page/interaction acceptance. Mirrored source routes can differ from generated published artifacts; source-only differences are not counted as confirmed production bugs.

findings.title: Review score overlaps slider hit target by 10.59375px
findings.root_cause: Fixed 40px/32px grid rows cannot contain a 55.2px number and 48px slider
findings.test: Existing quick-rate browser test:320/390/1348px geometry, Chromium and WebKit; captures screenshots

findings.title: Rating ranking audience scores show dash despite source score
findings.root_cause: Renderer mounts shared review with only id and title; source score and vote count dropped
findings.test: Existing ranking/calendar browser test through real ranking renderer; 8.4 score becomes4.2

findings.title: Light-theme ranking title and metadata unreadable against fixed dark wrapper
findings.root_cause: Theme sets dark text, integrated ranking wrapper fixes dark background
findings.test: Existing ranking/calendar browser test: title and metadata contrast >=4.5 in both themes

remaining_audit: Complete interaction, error/empty states, scroll and lower page content checks for active routes; do not equate 30 initial screenshots or CI success with bug-free UI.
